title: High Lemon Price
subtitle: Lemon prices remain above average even during the off-season due to low production
excerpt: Lemon prices high due to low production
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Lemon prices are above average, even during the off-season. This is due to low production, making it difficult to guarantee harvests.

Low Production and High Price

The low production of lemons is the main reason for the high price of the product. Those who have lemons available charge more for the product due to the difficulty in guaranteeing the harvest.

This situation directly affects the consumer, who has to pay more to acquire lemons.

With information from Agência Brasil.
